title_sq: SHESIM DUPLEX 3+2 NDËRTESA ME CABEJ TË VETME 190,000 €
description_sq:

• Sipërfaqja e brendshme: 124 m²
• Sipërfaqja totale bruto: 140 m²
• 3 dhoma gjumi
• 2 banjo
• Ka dokumentacion të rregullt pronësie

Për çdo informacion ose për të vizituar pronën, na kontaktoni.
title_en: SALE DUPLEX 3+2 BUILDING WITH SINGLE CABEJ €190,000
description_en: This modern duplex is located on the 7-8 floor of the Cabej buildings in Tirana and is for sale for €190,000. • Internal area: 124 m² • Total gross area: 140 m² • 3 bedrooms • 2 bathrooms • Has proper ownership documentation • Suitable for families looking for space and comfort. Investments made in the apartment: Solar panel, internal beech wood stairs connecting the two apartments, high quality investment doors, parquet floors, quality tiles in both bathrooms with natural ventilation, every room in the apartment has wardrobes. For any information or to visit the property, contact us.
